description: Epic and frantic battle! Help the wizard defeat the skeleton! Complete directional patterns under pressure while dodging deadly projectiles. Play alone or face your enemy in two-player mode with split arenas. Complete patterns quickly to build combos, regain health, and attack your opponent. If you need support, you can collect power-ups such as Platanus for health, Buk as a human resource , and AWS for infrastructure. Time is running out! Standing still is deadly!
